guard: membership reads and caller-owned watches recover across manual and terminal reconnects, races, and shutdown, with broker consumers deleted on replacement and stop
why: The live pre-fix reproduction proves the stale membership-feed cache fails after reconnect; the pinned client aborts that path after the named read failure, so it is not misreported as a mutation kill.

Four isolated mutations cleanly grade watch rearm, early consumer-identity ownership, closed-epoch cleanup deferral, and permanent-shutdown termination. Direct real-broker cells separately exercise quiet caller stop, predecessor cleanup after terminal self-heal, endpoint ownership during asynchronous cancellation, and rejected-chain recovery; their attempted mutations were removed because they hung, failed before the named cell, or were behaviorally redundant rather than clean named kills.

The manager-lease mutation restores the rebuild that kept `managerLeaseKv` bound to the drained connection: every renew and re-read after a reconnect then times out, and under the old fail-close that alone ended the manager ten seconds after any reconnect. The two lease cells are the only ones that see it.

mutations.name: reconnect drops the membership watch rearm call
mutations.expectRed: the membership feed watch stays live across reconnect
mutations.cell: the membership feed watch stays live across reconnect
mutations.note: The old iterator is retired and the intent never gets a successor, so the post-reconnect membership-rw write produces no callback.

mutations.name: public stop/close race forgets consumer identity before fresh cleanup
mutations.expectRed: public stop concurrent with terminal close resolves after fresh cleanup
mutations.cell: public stop concurrent with terminal close resolves after fresh cleanup
mutations.note: The consumer identity must survive its closed connection so the endpoint-owned public stop can finish only after fresh-epoch deletion.

mutations.name: closed epoch delete rejects public stop instead of deferring cleanup
mutations.expectRed: public stop concurrent with terminal close resolves after fresh cleanup
mutations.cell: public stop concurrent with terminal close resolves after fresh cleanup
mutations.note: A closed epoch is deferred cleanup, not deletion success and not a caller-visible stop failure.

mutations.name: endpoint shutdown leaves public membership stop pending while broker is down
mutations.expectRed: endpoint shutdown while broker is down settles the public membership stop
mutations.cell: endpoint shutdown while broker is down settles the public membership stop
mutations.note: Permanent endpoint shutdown has no possible fresh cleanup epoch; it must terminate a pending public stop rather than hanging the process.

mutations.name: the rebuild keeps the manager-lease KV handle bound to the drained connection
mutations.expectRed: the manager lease renews after reconnect
mutations.cell: the manager lease renews after reconnect (managerLeaseKv reopened on the fresh connection)
mutations.note: The shipped rebuild, restored: every other Plane-3 handle is dropped and this one is not. The renew CASes through a JetStream client whose connection was drained.

mutations.name: delivery durable bind drops the plane lease read
mutations.expectRed: a delivery durable bind refuses a plane with no ready delivery lease
mutations.cell: a delivery durable bind refuses a plane with no ready delivery lease
mutations.note: Without the liveness read the stale durable binds silently, restoring the reported empty-inbox behavior.

mutations.name: delivery durable bind inverts ready lease acceptance
mutations.find:
const liveDeliveryPlane = lease?.ready === true;
    if (!liveDeliveryPlane) throw refusal();
mutations.replace:
const liveDeliveryPlane = lease?.ready !== true;
    if (!liveDeliveryPlane) throw refusal();
mutations.expectRed: a quiet delivery durable binds while the plane holds a ready lease
mutations.cell: a quiet delivery durable binds while the plane holds a ready lease without raising an error
mutations.note: A ready live plane is the positive control and must remain the only accepted lease state.

mutations.name: delivery durable bind treats a missing lease row as live
mutations.replace: const liveDeliveryPlane = lease === undefined || lease.ready === true;
mutations.expectRed: a delivery durable bind refuses a plane with no ready delivery lease
mutations.cell: a delivery durable bind refuses a plane with no ready delivery lease
mutations.note: A missing lease is the stale-plane signal and must not collapse into a healthy quiet plane.
